title: "Pascoites Spot 'Mystery' Object" - Columbia Basin News, Pasco, Wash., July 29, 1952
description: Newspaper clipping with the large headline "Pascoites Spot 'Mystery' Object" and the article "'Saucer' Like Giant 'Pinwheel'," from the "Columbia Basin News," July 29, 1952, Pasco, Washington. The article reports a brilliant, high-speed object seen by five persons in the Navy Homes project, described as round, ringed with flashing lights and mostly green, and notes Army Air Force reports of such objects on radar. The page bears an FBI Seattle stamp dated JUL 30 1952 and file number 100-18945-35.
